# Fixture provenance

Synthetic fixtures generated by prepare_testdata.py; no patient data. Licensed Apache-2.0 with this repository.

`input.dcm` is a 6 x 6 mm macula (121 x 121 points, 0.05 mm) with a Gaussian foveal pit at the scan centre, so the thicknesses have known answers: 290.4 um away from the fovea and 201.3 um at the pit centre at the Spectralis axial size. `input-disc.dcm`, `input-empty.dcm` and `input-topcon.dcm` are authored cases the encoder must degrade on or read with another device's geometry. The frozen responses in expected.json are a regression baseline, not a clinical ground truth.
